scope: feature/teams-t1 branch — Phase T1: Teams Foundation (wf-b2532240)

findings.issue: Device code status poll mints unlimited tokens — every poll when status=approved creates a new JWT+refresh pair without marking the code as consumed
findings.recommendation: After generating tokens on first approved poll, immediately update device code status to 'used' in the same transaction. Return cached tokens on subsequent polls or reject as already consumed.

findings.issue: rejectUnauthorized: false disables SSL certificate verification for RDS connection — allows MITM attacks on database traffic
findings.recommendation: Set rejectUnauthorized: true and provide the RDS CA certificate bundle via the ca option. Download from https://truststore.pki.rds.amazonaws.com/global/global-bundle.pem

findings.issue: ProjectsFunction Lambda has no API Gateway routes — the projects endpoints are entirely unreachable
findings.recommendation: Add HttpApi routes for GET /api/teams/{teamId}/projects and POST /api/teams/{teamId}/projects pointing to ProjectsFunction

findings.issue: Path extraction rawPath.replace('/api/teams/', '') returns empty string for exact '/api/teams/' — teams list (GET) and create (POST) both return 404
findings.recommendation: Handle the base path explicitly: if path is '' or '/' after replace, route to list/create handlers

findings.issue: RDS SecurityGroup ingress 0.0.0.0/0 on port 5432 — database accessible from entire internet
findings.recommendation: Restrict to Lambda security group or VPC CIDR only

findings.issue: OAuth redirect URI not validated against an allowlist — open redirect vulnerability
findings.recommendation: Validate redirect_uri against a config allowlist of registered redirect URIs before initiating OAuth flow

findings.issue: CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on auth endpoints — allows any website to make credentialed requests
findings.recommendation: Set specific allowed origins from config/env, not wildcard

findings.issue: TOCTOU race on slug uniqueness — SELECT check followed by INSERT without serializable isolation allows duplicate slugs under concurrent requests
findings.recommendation: Use INSERT with ON CONFLICT or a unique constraint + retry logic instead of check-then-insert

findings.issue: Non-atomic team creation — INSERT team and INSERT team_member run as separate queries with no transaction, leaving orphaned teams on member insert failure
findings.recommendation: Wrap team creation + owner membership insert in a database transaction (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK)

findings.issue: JWT scopes claim is present in token payload but never enforced — requireAuth middleware checks token validity but ignores scopes
findings.recommendation: Add a requireScope(scope) middleware that checks req.user.scopes.includes(scope)

findings.issue: GitHub email fallback uses first email from /user/emails without checking verified:true flag — could use unverified email for account creation
findings.recommendation: Filter emails array for verified:true before selecting primary email

findings.issue: audit_log.resource_id typed as UUID but device-auth passes string device_code (64-char hex, not UUID format) — INSERT will fail with type error
findings.recommendation: Change resource_id to TEXT, or convert device codes to UUID format before logging

findings.issue: Modulo bias in user code generation: randomBytes[i] % 27 biases toward first 13 characters (256 mod 27 = 13)
findings.recommendation: Use rejection sampling: discard bytes >= 27 * Math.floor(256/27) and retry

findings.issue: No refresh token replay detection — a stolen refresh token can be used until it's rotated by legitimate user
findings.recommendation: Implement refresh token family tracking: if a rotated token is reused, invalidate the entire family (all descendant tokens)

findings.issue: sessionStorage doesn't persist across tabs — user must re-authenticate in each new tab
findings.recommendation: Consider localStorage with XSS protections, or use httpOnly cookies for token transport

findings.issue: logAudit() defined in teams.js — should be a shared utility since audit logging is cross-cutting
findings.recommendation: Extract to lib/audit.js for reuse by auth, device-auth, and future modules

findings.issue: Duplicated JSON body parsing boilerplate across auth.js, device-auth.js, and teams.js route handlers
findings.recommendation: Extract parseJsonBody() utility to a shared middleware or util module

findings.issue: OAuth state token has no explicit TTL check — relies on DB cleanup rather than expiry validation at consume time
findings.recommendation: Add created_at + TTL check when consuming state tokens

findings.issue: findUserByEmail used for member addition but no invitation flow for non-existent users (spec says 'or invite created')
findings.recommendation: Implement pending invitation table or return clear error distinguishing 'user not found' from 'user found but not added'

findings.issue: validateOAuthCallback doesn't validate state parameter format (should be hex string of specific length)
findings.recommendation: Add state format validation: /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/

findings.issue: Inline device code validation instead of using validate.js — inconsistent with validation pattern
findings.recommendation: Create validateDeviceCodeStatus() in validate.js

findings.issue: Duplicated Secrets Manager caching logic in auth.js and oauth.js (both implement 15-min TTL cache)
findings.recommendation: Extract getSecretCached(secretName, ttl) to a shared secrets.js module

findings.issue: UUID regex [0-9a-f-]{36} accepts malformed UUIDs (e.g., all hyphens '----...----')
Pre-fill from URL ?code= parameter without URL decoding — encoded characters won't display correctly
findings.recommendation: Use decodeURIComponent(params.get('code'))

findings.issue: Rate limit by IP only — no user-agent or fingerprint for additional entropy
findings.recommendation: Consider adding user-agent hash as secondary rate limit key to prevent IP sharing bypasses

findings.issue: Unit tests re-implement production logic (slugify, formatCode, isValidUserCode) instead of importing from source modules
findings.recommendation: Export and import these functions from the source modules for testing

findings.issue: Magic number 50000 (response size limit) — should be a named constant
findings.recommendation: const MAX_OAUTH_RESPONSE_BYTES = 50_000;

findings.issue: Magic string '15m' for token TTL — should be a named constant
findings.recommendation: const ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL = '15m';

findings.issue: Inline CSS styles instead of external stylesheet — fine for MVP but increases duplication
findings.recommendation: Consider extracting shared styles to a CSS file when dashboard grows

findings.issue: Minimal error context in 500 responses — just 'Internal server error' with no request correlation
findings.recommendation: Add request ID or correlation ID to error responses for debugging

findings.issue: getTeamDetails returns null for non-existent team — caller must null-check
findings.recommendation: This is fine for internal API usage; just ensure all callers handle null

findings.issue: Constants (USER_CODE_CHARS, EXPIRES_IN, etc.) not exported — tests re-implement them
findings.recommendation: Export constants for test consumption

findings.issue: Inconsistent max-length checks across validators (team name 100, project name 100, email 254)
findings.recommendation: Document the rationale for each limit; 254 for email is correct per RFC 5321

findings.issue: CloudFormation outputs only include ApiUrl — no RDS endpoint or Lambda ARNs for operational use
findings.recommendation: Add outputs for RDS endpoint, Lambda function ARNs for debugging and monitoring setup
